about: The picture a link to a page of clinx.org shows when it is shared. One entry per card. scripts/brand/make-share-cards.mjs draws the PNGs from this list, the site picks a card by the page's section, and check-dist checks every page names one of them. Keep the lines free of anything that goes out of date, such as a count.
bright_about: The bright tiles on every card are the states with a 340B reporting law, the same states the Scorecard lists. A test compares this list with the site's registry, so a new state fails the test until the cards are drawn again.
